# partiteai_skill (Resource)

A skill: instructions an agent loads when a task calls for them, with the files those instructions refer to. The skill is its folder of files, `SKILL.md` among them; the front matter of `SKILL.md` gives the name the agent knows the skill by and its description. Agents use a skill through the agent resource's `skills` attribute. Skills with a `scripts` folder or with files that are not text are refused.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Map of String) The files of the skill folder, by path, as text. Paths are relative to the folder, such as `SKILL.md` or `reference/forms.md`. Must include `SKILL.md`. A change replaces all of the skill's files.
- `name` (String) The skill's own name, unique across skills. Two skills can come from folders that declare the same name, such as two copies of one skill.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `declared_name` (String) The name `SKILL.md` declares. The agent knows the skill by it, so an agent can't use two skills with the same declared name.
- `description` (String) The description `SKILL.md` declares. It tells the agent when to use the skill.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `instructions` (String) The body of `SKILL.md`, after its front matter.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
